rows.grounds: locative singular feminine participle of vidyamāna
comparative adjective balīyas in feminine nominative singular

items.question: Can a modification be stronger than the original nature that persists?
premises: prakṛti exists in its own state
vikṛti is not stronger than prakṛti
items.inference: When nature exists, modification cannot overpower it.
uncertainties: exact doctrinal referent of prakṛti and vikṛti in this context
items.plain_english: When nature exists, modification is not stronger.
